title: Part Ten: The Documents and the Myths

sections.brief: Authentic but narrow: Genesis 15:18 and its readings; Herzl's 1898 diary note (Pipes confirms the note, debunks only that it was requested; corrects Book 4 and rd1 s04); the ZO Paris statement of 3 Feb 1919 (south of Sidon to the Hejaz Railway); Rabbi Fishman's 'From Egypt to the Euphrates' answer to UNSCOP, July 1947 (JTA). Figure: compare

Misread: Yinon 1982 (Kivunim, author, fragmentation not annexation, Sinai the only Israeli aim, scholars split, later conspiracy uses, no adoption); A Clean Break 1996 (keep the Golan, 'peace for peace', 'claim to the land', no West Bank mention; Hebron 1997 and Wye 1998 signed), consistent with ir13_papers; the 10-agora coin (Arafat at UNSC Geneva 25 May 1990, Rowley vs Berkowicz, Bank of Israel: Antigonus replica). Figure: compare

Myths: the Knesset 'Nile to Euphrates' inscription (CSM correction 1980, Asad/Tlas 1982, Arafat 1990, Knesset hall description); the flag stripes (Arafat Playboy 1988, Hamas Art. 32, MFA tallit origin, Wolffsohn, 28 Oct 1948 adoption); why the classes must be kept apart; nine-item ledger. Figures: time; compare
